pairing.title: Pair this till
pairing.intro: Ask an admin for a pairing code under Settings, Devices. The code works once and expires after 15 minutes.
pairing.codeHelp: 8 letters and digits. There is no 0, O, 1, I or L.
pairing.name: Till name
pairing.nameHelp: Admins see this name in the device list.
pairing.pairedNoLocation: This till is paired. Its location appears after the first sync.

errors.invalid_code: This pairing code is not valid or has expired. Ask an admin for a new code.
errors.name_required: Enter a name for this till.
errors.too_many_attempts: Too many tries. Wait a minute, then enter the code again.
errors.offline: The server cannot be reached. Check the connection, then try again.
errors.failed: Pairing did not work. Try again, or ask an admin for a new code.

pairing.unsent_one: {{count}} record from this till’s earlier pairing was not uploaded. It is kept for review; ask an admin to pair the till as its former device to send it.
pairing.unsent_other: {{count}} records from this till’s earlier pairing were not uploaded. They are kept for review; ask an admin to pair the till as its former device to send them.

signIn.title: Who is selling?
signIn.subtitle: Choose your name, then enter your PIN.
signIn.empty: No staff can sign in at this till yet. Ask an admin to give staff a role at this location, then sync.

errors.incorrect_one: Wrong PIN. {{count}} try left before this PIN locks on this till.
errors.incorrect_other: Wrong PIN. {{count}} tries left before this PIN locks on this till.
errors.locked: This PIN is locked on this till after 5 wrong tries. Set a new PIN in the back office, or ask a manager to reset it.
errors.not_set: You have no PIN yet. Set one in the back office under your profile.
errors.not_staff: You cannot sign in at this till. Ask an admin to give you a role at this location.
errors.online_required: Your PIN can only be checked online. Connect the till, then try again.
errors.access_lost: This till has lost access. Ask an admin to check the device.
errors.failed: Sign-in did not work. Try again.

changePin.title: Choose a new PIN
changePin.intro: Your PIN was reset. Choose a new one before you sell.
changePin.rules: 4 to 6 digits. Managers who approve need 6. Avoid 1234, 0000 and dates.
changePin.mismatch: The two PINs differ. Enter the new PIN again.
changePin.offline: Changing a PIN needs a connection. You can sell now; you will be asked again when the till is online.
changePin.failed: The PIN was not changed. Try again.

home.failed_one: {{count}} record was refused by the server and needs review.
home.failed_other: {{count}} records were refused by the server and need review.
home.accessLost: The device was unpaired or suspended. Unsent sales stay on this till. Ask an admin to resume the device, then try again.
home.secretMissing: This till has no offline sign-in key. Staff can sign in online only until the till is paired again.
home.pinChangeOffline: Choose a new PIN when the till is back online.
home.moduleInactive: The POS module is not active for your business. Sales stay on this till and upload once it is active again.

search.label: Search products
search.none: No products match. Try another name or code.
search.emptyCatalogue: No products on this till yet. Sync, or add items in the back office.
search.unknown: No product has the code {{code}}. Check the code, or search by name.

sale.title: Current sale
sale.empty: Tap a product or scan a barcode to start a sale.
sale.blocked: Some items cannot be sold until their tax rate is set in the back office. Remove them to charge.
sale.discountCleared: The discount was removed: it is above what you may give at this quantity. Ask a manager to give it again.

offline.note: Offline: sales are recorded on this till and uploaded when you reconnect.
offline.noteKe: Offline: cash and M-Pesa till payments are recorded and sent to KRA eTIMS when you reconnect.
offline.noteCd: Offline: sales are recorded and sent to the DGI when you reconnect.

line.discountHelp: A discount above your limit needs a manager.

errors.qty: Enter a quantity above 0, with at most 6 decimals.
errors.price: Enter the unit price as an amount.
errors.discount: The discount must be an amount no higher than the line price.

customer.title: Customer
customer.none: No customer matches. Check the spelling or the number.

held.title: Held sales
held.none: No held sales on this till.

override.title: Manager approval

why.discount: This discount is above your limit. A manager approves it with their PIN.
why.price: Changing the price needs a manager. A manager approves it with their PIN.
why.void: Voiding a sale needs a manager. A manager approves it with their PIN.
why.refund: This refund needs a manager. A manager approves it with their PIN.
why.pay_out: Paying cash out needs a manager. A manager approves it with their PIN.
why.pay_in: Paying cash in needs a manager. A manager approves it with their PIN.

override.nobody: No one at this till can approve this. Ask an admin to give a manager a role here, then sync.
override.noSecret: This till cannot sign approvals without its offline key. Pair the till again.

pay.title: Payment
pay.none: No payments yet. Choose a payment method.
pay.mobileManual: The customer pays to the till number. Type the code from the confirmation message; it is checked when the till syncs.

stk.title: Request sent to the customer’s phone
stk.body: The customer confirms with their PIN. The payment adds itself once confirmed.

pay.noMethods: No payment methods for this company yet. Add them in the back office, then sync.

errors.mobileCode: Type the M-Pesa code from the customer’s message: 8 to 12 letters and digits.
errors.rate_unavailable: There is no exchange rate for this currency. Take payment in the sale currency, or sync for today’s rates.
errors.sale_underpaid: The payments do not cover the total yet.
errors.no_receipt_numbers: This till has no receipt numbers left. Connect to the internet so the server can give it more, then complete the sale.
errors.lines_blocked: Some items cannot be sold until their tax rate is set. Remove them, then charge.
errors.failed: The sale was not saved. Try again.

receipt.fiscalPendingHelp: The authority’s code and QR code are added once the sale reaches the server and the authority accepts it.

shift.openIntro: {{name}}, count the cash in the drawer before you start.
shift.closeIntro: Count the cash in the drawer per currency. Expected cash is shown after you close.
shift.heldWarning_one: {{count}} held sale stays on this till and is not part of this shift.
shift.heldWarning_other: {{count}} held sales stay on this till and are not part of this shift.
shift.serverRecounts: The server recounts expected cash from the records it accepts; the back office shows the final figures.

errors.amount: Enter the {{currency}} amount as a number.
errors.failed: The shift was not saved. Try again.

errors.incomplete: Enter an amount above 0 and a reason.
errors.failed: The cash movement was not saved. Try again.

sales.title: Sales and returns
sales.notFound: No sale on this till has that receipt number. Check the number on the receipt.
sales.none: No sales on this till yet.
sales.pickLines: Choose the items the customer brings back, or void the whole sale.

errors.refundIncomplete: Choose the items, a way to pay back and a reason.
errors.refund_currency: This refund cannot be paid in that currency at the sale’s rate. Choose the sale currency.
errors.refund_qty_exceeded: More than was sold would be returned. Lower the quantity.
errors.refund_empty: Choose at least one item to return.
errors.sale_has_refunds: Items of this sale were returned, so it cannot be voided. Return the rest instead.
errors.void_other_shift: Only sales of the open shift can be voided. Return the items instead.
errors.no_receipt_numbers: This till has no refund numbers left. Connect to the internet so the server can give it more.
